title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Exponential regularization involves the term $${10}^{\theta_i}$$. How does this affect the penalty on coefficients compared to L1 and L2 regularization?

title: Comparing Penalties on Positive Coefficients
text: Consider a large positive coefficient $$\theta_i$$. How does $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ compare to $${\theta_i}^2$$ (L2) and $$|\theta_i|$$ (L1)?

title: Comparing Penalties on Negative Coefficients
text: For a large negative coefficient $$\theta_i$$, how does $${10}^{\theta_i}$$ compare to $${\theta_i}^2$$ (L2) and $$|\theta_i|$$ (L1)?

title: Effectiveness in Driving Parameters to Zero
text: Which regularization method is more effective in driving parameters close to zero? Consider the nature of each regularization term.
